title: Fail closed when DXF cannot represent a DWG fit-SPLINE knot parameterization
scope: Prevent DXF serialization of R2013+ DWG fit-point SPLINE profiles whose knot parameterization changes curve shape but has no corresponding DXF field. Keep the documented chord-default profile available.

formatEvidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
formatEvidence.finding: R2013+ Spline flags 1 are a BL; fit-method is bit 1 and use-knot-parameter is bit 8. Knot parameter values are Chord=0, Square root=1, Uniform=2, Custom=15. A fit-point scenario with an active knot parameter uses the selected parameterization.

formatEvidence.title: Autodesk SPLINE DXF reference
formatEvidence.finding: The documented AcDbSpline group-code inventory includes fit points, tangents, fit tolerance, flags, degree, knots, controls and weights; it has no knot-parameterization selector.

formatEvidence.title: Autodesk AcDbSpline fit-point constructor
formatEvidence.finding: Autodesk documents chord, square-root-chord and uniform options, states that the knot sequence affects curve shape, and identifies chord as this constructor's default.

formatEvidence.title: Physical AC1027 fit-only SPLINE differential
formatEvidence.finding: The two public AC1027 witness splines have splFlag1=9 and knotParam=0; their decoded typed fields match LibreDWG 0.14 and ODA v5.4.1. The public sample was research input only and is not committed as a DWG fixture.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Spline::validateDxf rejects the R2013+ fit-only profile when m_scenario is 2, both method-fit-points/use-knot-parameter bits are set, and m_knotParam is not chord (0). Control-point splines and ordinary DXF-authored objects with no DWG-only metadata are unaffected. The guard runs before writeSpline emits the SPLINE record.
implementation.retryControl: The existing --spline-fit-only-dxf ASCII/Binary control sets the typed model's DWG-only metadata to an AC1027 fit profile, confirms square-root-chord (1) and uniform (2) each refuse without mutating that metadata, then changes to chord (0) and successfully retries through the same dx_iface before checking raw group codes and typed readback.

focusedTest.result: PASS, 1/1; ASCII and Binary refusal for parameterizations 1/2 followed by same-adapter chord-default retry and output/readback

limitations: No independent curve-evaluation comparison or native CAD interpretation was run; this is a fail-closed encoding rule supported by the DWG layout and DXF field contract.
The physical AC1027 witness uses chord parameterization only; non-default source production is covered by a locally generated in-memory model, not a physical DWG fixture.
The change does not qualify whole-document AC1027 output, general SPLINE/NURBS semantics, other DWG versions, or 3D support claims.

planImpact.completedSlice: Refused DWG fit-only SPLINE knot parameterizations that DXF cannot encode while retaining the documented chord-default export profile; covered ASCII/Binary failure and same-adapter retry.
planImpact.remaining: Curve-equivalence and native consumer evidence; physical non-default producer profiles; broad SPLINE/NURBS/geometry qualification and remaining P6 boundaries.
planImpact.nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 residual audit on a source-backed schema family; do not alter DWG SPLINE wire parsing without a new failing producer trace.
